subject: Multi-day consolidation & proctoring plan for FinPath enablement
messages:
From: Samir Gupta <samir@finpath.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Alicia Ramos <alicia.ramos@finpath.com>
Date: Tue, 13 Jun 2028 09:02:00 -0700
Subject: Planning: multi-team enablement — proposed format

Evelyn / Marissa,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the leadership team at FinPath wants to move to a hands-on enablement for three engineering pods and one product squad.

High-level ask: two half-day sessions (console walkthrough + API enablement), run back-to-back over two days so we can keep momentum and let cross-team folks pair. Prefer the week of June 18 if you have capacity.

Attendees: ~18 engineers (mixed seniority), 4 product owners. We will send a roster but expect at least two people per pod to join both sessions.

Open questions for you:
- Can Redwood split leads so we have a dedicated console walkthrough owner and an API lead?
- Can you provide a short preflight checklist and a sandbox/service account for the API hands-on?
- Any limits on attendee numbers for the live lab?

If June 18–19 works, we will lock times once you confirm. Also happy to take two half-days later in the week if you prefer.

Thanks,
Samir
Samir Gupta
Director of Engineering
FinPath

Hi Samir — thanks for the clear summary. We can absolutely do a two half-day cadence and will assign separate leads for console vs API. A few quick things before we lock: 

- Preference: Redwood suggests morning blocks 9:00–12:30 PT both days (includes a short break) — keeps afternoons open for follow-ups. If your teams are APAC-heavy we can shift later.
- Sandbox creds: we will provision scoped service accounts for each pod. I need a little info from you (list of emails + desired RBAC level).
- Capacity: comfortable up to 25 interactive seats per session; larger groups can join the broadcast 

I'll loop in Marissa to confirm leads and attach our preflight checklist and the mutual action plan template. Can you send a quick attendee roster and confirm whether you want split rooms for product vs eng?

Best,
Evelyn Hart
Senior Customer Success Manager
Redwood Inference
